# Security policy

## Supported surfaces

Security reports are accepted for:

- the hosted product application associated with this repository
- Builder Kernel (`src/lib/builder`)
- Plugin SDK (`src/lib/plugin-sdk`)
- CI / deployment configuration in this repository

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please **do not** open a public issue with exploit details.

Prefer:

1. GitHub Security Advisories for this repository (if enabled), or
2. Private contact with the repository owner (`@youh4ck3dme`)

Include:

- affected component and version / commit
- reproduction steps (local / non-production data when possible)
- impact assessment

## Documentation

Threat model and known limitations: [docs/SECURITY.md](../docs/SECURITY.md)

## Disclosure

There is no published SLA yet. Maintainers will acknowledge reports as capacity allows. A formal response-time policy is **Planned**.
